ai.seo_question: 在什叶派法学中，礼拜中的泰沙胡德是主命还是可嘉？
ai.summary: 在《塔赫迪卜·阿尔·阿赫卡姆》的这段圣训中，伊玛目萨迪格（愿主福安之）阐明，详细的泰沙胡德（Tashahhud）并非严格意义上的主命（wajib），因为 rigid adherence to a fixed text would burden the people, leading to potential error or omission. He establishes that while the two testimonies of faith are mandatory, the additional supplications are recommended (sunnah), reflecting the early Muslim practice of reciting whatever was easiest to remember after praising Allah. This distinction underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of balancing ritual precision with practical ease (yusr) in acts of worship.
